Description

House

Located on the popular Zoutrootjesstraat, a quiet and green residential street in Linden (Lubbeek), this charming semi-detached home sits on a beautiful lot measuring 7a 75ca. The home enjoys an excellent location in a residential neighborhood, close to Kessel-Lo and within walking and biking distance of numerous amenities. Here, you’ll be close to local shops, restaurants, schools, youth clubs, and sports facilities. In addition, there are beautiful walking, cycling, and mountain biking trails in the surrounding fields and forests.

This charming home currently offers a solid foundation but requires a thorough renovation, giving you the unique opportunity to transform it entirely to your own taste and in line with contemporary standards.
On the ground floor, you enter the home through the entry hall, which leads to a bright living area with an adjoining dining area and kitchen. The first floor features three bedrooms. Additionally, the attic offers interesting expansion possibilities for extra room(s) or a hobby room.

The home also features a spacious basement with a recently installed gas condensing boiler, a detached garage, parking on the driveway, and a deep, southwest-facing garden,

A unique opportunity for anyone looking for a home with character. Call or email Robin at 0487 37 48 84 or robin@connect-immo.be.
